classes.label: Label Property
classes.comment: A foaf:LabelProperty is any RDF property with texual values that serve as labels.

classes.label: Agent
classes.comment: An agent (eg. person, group, software or physical artifact).

classes.label: Project
classes.comment: A project (a collective endeavour of some kind).

properties.label: personal mailbox
properties.comment: A  personal mailbox, ie. an Internet mailbox associated with exactly one owner, the first owner of this mailbox. This is a 'static inverse functional property', in that  there is (across time and change) at most one individual that ever has any particular value for foaf:mbox.

properties.label: sha1sum of a personal mailbox URI name
properties.comment: The sha1sum of the URI of an Internet mailbox associated with exactly one owner, the  first owner of the mailbox.

properties.label: gender
properties.comment: The gender of this Agent (typically but not necessarily 'male' or 'female').

properties.label: geekcode
properties.comment: A textual geekcode for this person, see http://www.geekcode.com/geek.html

properties.label: DNA checksum
properties.comment: A checksum for the DNA of some thing. Joke.

properties.label: sha1sum (hex)
properties.comment: A sha1sum hash, in hex.

properties.label: based near
properties.comment: A location that something is based near, for some broadly human notion of near.

properties.label: title
properties.comment: Title (Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr. etc)

properties.label: nickname
properties.comment: A short informal nickname characterising an agent (includes login identifiers, IRC and other chat nicknames).

properties.label: jabber ID
properties.comment: A jabber ID for something.

properties.label: AIM chat ID
properties.comment: An AIM chat ID

properties.label: Skype ID
properties.comment: A Skype ID

properties.label: ICQ chat ID
properties.comment: An ICQ chat ID

properties.label: Yahoo chat ID
properties.comment: A Yahoo chat ID

properties.label: MSN chat ID
properties.comment: An MSN chat ID

properties.label: name
properties.comment: A name for some thing.

properties.label: firstName
properties.comment: The first name of a person.

properties.label: lastName
properties.comment: The last name of a person.

properties.label: Given name
properties.comment: The given name of some person.

properties.label: Given name
properties.comment: The given name of some person.

properties.label: Surname
properties.comment: The surname of some person.

properties.label: family_name
properties.comment: The family name of some person.

properties.label: familyName
properties.comment: The family name of some person.

properties.label: phone
properties.comment: A phone,  specified using fully qualified tel: URI scheme (refs: http://www.w3.org/Addressing/schemes.html#tel).

properties.label: homepage
properties.comment: A homepage for some thing.

properties.label: weblog
properties.comment: A weblog of some thing (whether person, group, company etc.).

properties.label: openid
properties.comment: An OpenID for an Agent.

properties.label: tipjar
properties.comment: A tipjar document for this agent, describing means for payment and reward.

properties.label: plan
properties.comment: A .plan comment, in the tradition of finger and '.plan' files.

properties.label: made
properties.comment: Something that was made by this agent.

properties.label: maker
properties.comment: An agent that  made this thing.

properties.label: image
properties.comment: An image that can be used to represent some thing (ie. those depictions which are particularly representative of something, eg. one's photo on a homepage).

properties.label: depiction
properties.comment: A depiction of some thing.

properties.label: depicts
properties.comment: A thing depicted in this representation.

properties.label: thumbnail
properties.comment: A derived thumbnail image.

properties.label: myersBriggs
properties.comment: A Myers Briggs (MBTI) personality classification.

properties.label: workplace homepage
properties.comment: A workplace homepage of some person; the homepage of an organization they work for.

properties.label: work info homepage
properties.comment: A work info homepage of some person; a page about their work for some organization.

properties.label: schoolHomepage
properties.comment: A homepage of a school attended by the person.

properties.label: knows
properties.comment: A person known by this person (indicating some level of reciprocated interaction between the parties).

properties.label: interest
properties.comment: A page about a topic of interest to this person.

properties.label: topic_interest
properties.comment: A thing of interest to this person.

properties.label: publications
properties.comment: A link to the publications of this person.

properties.label: current project
properties.comment: A current project this person works on.

properties.label: past project
properties.comment: A project this person has previously worked on.

properties.label: funded by
properties.comment: An organization funding a project or person.

properties.label: logo
properties.comment: A logo representing some thing.

properties.label: topic
properties.comment: A topic of some page or document.

properties.label: primary topic
properties.comment: The primary topic of some page or document.

properties.label: focus
properties.comment: The underlying or 'focal' entity associated with some SKOS-described concept.

properties.label: is primary topic of
properties.comment: A document that this thing is the primary topic of.

properties.label: page
properties.comment: A page or document about this thing.

properties.label: theme
properties.comment: A theme.

properties.label: account
properties.comment: Indicates an account held by this agent.

properties.label: account
properties.comment: Indicates an account held by this agent.

properties.label: account service homepage
properties.comment: Indicates a homepage of the service provide for this online account.

properties.label: account name
properties.comment: Indicates the name (identifier) associated with this online account.

properties.label: member
properties.comment: Indicates a member of a Group

properties.label: membershipClass
properties.comment: Indicates the class of individuals that are a member of a Group

properties.label: birthday
properties.comment: The birthday of this Agent, represented in mm-dd string form, eg. '12-31'.

properties.label: age
properties.comment: The age in years of some agent.

properties.label: status
properties.comment: A string expressing what the user is happy for the general public (normally) to know about their current activity.
